text: From T-K34H3 (phone makes Kokoro voices itself, TJ decision: no voice audio over the network). I need two small changes in files you hold, or your OK for me to make them: (1) bridge: each reply item carries its project's voice, item.voice = {parts:[[name,weight]...], speed} from lib/speaker.mjs voiceFor({project}); and when the phone's hello says ondevice:true, the bridge sends no clip messages (skip Voicer). (2) Link.kt: on 'reply' (and when items merge), call a new PhoneVoice.reply(items) I am writing in new file PhoneVoice.kt, which fills link.clips itself; askClips goes to PhoneVoice instead of the bridge when the model is installed. Which do you prefer: you do them, or I do them after you release those paths?
You do them: I released mobile/bridge and Link.kt just now. Keep my changes there (moved/walk:false, started.of, outbox, asking/arriving, hello version). I still hold WalkPlan.kt and the tests.
